answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The relic is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the island. What survives to the vault is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
